liceworld:arcticsuit-handbook-help-text: A set of clothes built to resist apocalyptically cold temperatures of the surface. It's your only hope against freezing to death in the harsh surface environment.
liceworld:cavewheat-handbook-help-text: A genetically modified wheat variety designed to thrive in cave environments with low, stable temperatures and no light. It grows relatively well but has a distinctly rocky taste with a grainy texture and hard lumps.
liceworld:bread-handbook-help-text: A staple food made from cave wheat flour, water, and yeast. If you couldn't eat it you could be sure that a rock. At least its soft.
liceworld:dough-handbook-help-text: A soft paste made from cave wheat flour and liquid. The dough has a grainy texture with hard lumps that never fully disappear.
liceworld:flour-handbook-help-text: A coarse powder made by grinding cave wheat. Its not sand but pretty close, at leat you can eat it.
liceworld:grain-handbook-help-text: The harvested seeds of cave wheat. These grains have a rocky taste with and they are almost as hard as a rock, that make them difficult to eat raw.
liceworld:cider-handbook-help-text: A fermented cave wheat beverage. Have you ever wanted to drink a rock... Well that's the closest well ever get.
liceworld:spirit-handbook-help-text: A distilled spirit made from fermented cave wheat. You could taste rock before, now after one sip you wont taste anything else for days.
liceworld:seeds-handbook-help-text: The small, fertile seeds of cave wheat. The peak of mankind genetical engeneering, to bad they didn't contact anyone to test the result.
